newsitem.title: USA: Aspect to acquire Envoy Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Aspect to acquire Envoy Holdings.

text.p: Aspect Telecommunications Corp and Envoy Holdings Ltd said on Monday they had signed a definitive agreement for Aspect to acquire Envoy in a stock swap.
About 105,000 Aspect shares will be exchanged for for all of Envoy's outstanding stock, they said.
Based on Aspect's closing price of $56.75 on September 13, the transaction is valued at about $6 million, they said.
The companies said the transaction is expected to be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is expected to close at the end of September.
Aspect said it will record a non-recurring charge for transaction-related expenses of $0.01 to $0.02 per diluted share in the third quarter.
After including Envoy's results of operations for all of 1996, the incremental effect on Aspect's full-year fiscal 1996 revenues is expected to be an increase of about $4 million, Aspect said.
The companies said the transaction is expected to be neutral to slightly positive to Aspect's net earnings for the year, excluding the non-recurring charge.

Envoy's staff of about 35 is set to join Aspect's recently formed Consulting and Systems Integration business unit and will continue to operate from existing facilities in Richmond, England, outside London.
